rule: per stream, keep picks whose local power (pick_stats/power) is in the top keep_frac within their 0.25 um defocus bin, computed on that stream's own picks
why: v1 (pick_power_filter.json, absolute pilot thresholds from 80-140 A circular blobs) kept only 19,937/1,583,293 rod picks: the 20-180 A ellipse picker's power scale is ~2.5x lower (median 212 vs 547). Pilot: noise-class picks were ~34% of 80-140 A blob picks.
